observation_summary: The .asPath() method produced incorrect XPath strings or entered an infinite loop when processing nodes with empty namespace declarations.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurred because the DOMNodePointer class was returning an empty string (" ") for nodes without a namespace, whereas the JXPath framework expects a null value to represent the absence of a namespace. This inconsistency caused the .asPath() method to fail or loop infinitely when resolving paths for nodes that explicitly had an empty namespace attribute. The fix ensures that any empty string returned as a namespace URI is converted to null, aligning the DOM model's behavior with the rest of the framework.
